name: Andaz Bali
insider_take: Where contemporary luxury meets ancient Balinese spirituality in the creative heart of Sanur
whats_special: This stunning beachfront property sits on Sanur's legendary sunrise beach, where traditional fishing boats still dot the horizon at dawn. The hotel's design incorporates sacred Balinese architectural principles, with each villa positioned according to ancient feng shui traditions. Andaz Bali is also home to one of the island's most extensive contemporary art collections, featuring works by renowned Indonesian artists.
pro_tip: Book a sunrise yoga session on the beach – Sanur's east-facing coastline offers Bali's most spectacular dawn views, and the calm morning waters are perfect for a post-session swim.
dont_miss: The weekly traditional kite-flying sessions with local craftsmen – Sanur is the birthplace of Bali's famous giant kites, and the hotel offers exclusive workshops where guests can create and fly their own traditional Balinese kites on the beach.
pros: Contemporary Balinese design with stunning ocean views
Multiple dining venues showcasing local Indonesian cuisine
Beautiful beachfront location on Sanur Beach
Hyatt Privé benefits including room upgrades and resort credits
cons: Limited nightlife options in surrounding Sanur area
Distance from popular Seminyak and Canggu beach clubs
